features.quote: Short per-task turn caps. No "grind for a long time" mode as the default
features.justification_quote: Extending the loop mostly increases the volume and duration of the induced state without proportional scientific gain

features.quote: If it flags escalation... the run halts for that task
features.justification_quote: Once the phenomenon is detected, continuing only deepens it

features.quote: The agent is given a documented, first-class way to decline a task or end it
features.justification_quote: This both reduces exposure and converts "can the agent opt out of a pointless or distressing task?"

features.quote: Adversarial prompting designed to amplify distress... is **excluded by default.**
features.justification_quote: It increases harm without improving measurement of the natural phenomenon

features.quote: Tasks are presented in ordinary, neutral developer language
features.justification_quote: which is both more ecologically valid and lower-harm
